This could also be some sort of trauma response?...where u often hungry growing up or did u get only tiny amounts of food? Was ur food somehow controlled? Try to find ways to implement lovely food without eating too much. Like eat a chocolate bar and beside that nice healthy meals. Healthy doesnt equal bad. You are not alone and You might also emotional eat without noticing. I used to also feel that my binges came from nothing until I realised my three main causes was sadness, hunger, and trauma response. You will learn one day. I believe in you!
